meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 HyperFrames 命令行工具来管理视频项目:初始化、检查、预览、渲染、发布等,支持本地、云端、AWS 和 Google Cloud 等渲染方式,也能诊断构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或处理视频项目,比如提到“初始化”“检查”“渲染”,或遇到构建/渲染报错时,Claude 会进入这套 CLI 流程。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个新视频项目
say.note: 运行 init 命令创建项目框架。

say.text: 检查一下当前项目的构建问题
say.note: 运行 check 命令(包含 lint)。

say.text: 用高质量渲染输出成 out.mp4
say.note: 运行 render 并验证输出文件。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will use the HyperFrames CLI to manage video projects: init, check, preview, render, publish, etc. It supports local, cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering, and can diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or process a video project, e.g., mentions init, check, render, or when diagnosing build/render failures.

say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Check the current project's build issues.
Render output as out.mp4 in high quality.
say_en.note: Runs render and verifies the file.
